label: sec:descartes-theorem-intro
html: The preceding sections showed that a genus-four curve with \chi = -6 supports three colour tubes, a three-generation torus-knot filtration, and a Legendrian cohomological defect. The Descartes theorem establishes the converse uniqueness property: in the category of quantum observable universes satisfying the Descartes condition \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0) = -6 with faithful five-fold permutation symmetry, Bring's surface \Sigma_4 is the terminal object, and its Yekutieli tower provides a canonical continuum limit for lattice gauge theory.
